objective: Determine whether absolute owner separation D0/D1 remains necessary in the preferred roleless/depthless SIGNED_PARITY exchange carrier, using frozen owner-symmetry quotients before scalar replay.

ownerModes.name: D_MERGED
ownerModes.definition: Replace D0/D1 by total signed depth-change counts D+=D0+ + D1+, D-=D0- + D1-.

ownerModes.name: D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS
ownerModes.definition: Retain D+/D- totals plus owner-swap-invariant absolute imbalances |D0+-D1+| and |D0--D1-|; discard which absolute owner carries each imbalance and discard plus/minus cross-owner pairing.

ownerModes.name: D_UNORDERED_CHANNELS
ownerModes.definition: Retain the two owner channel vectors (D0+,D0-) and (D1+,D1-) as an unordered sorted pair; owner labels are removed while owner-channel separation and plus/minus pairing are retained.

ownerModes.name: D_SEPARATED
ownerModes.definition: Retain exact absolute owner-separated counts D0+,D0-,D1+,D1-; reconstruction control.

structuralProcedure: Start from each frozen RS-073 SIGNED_PARITY C_ROLELESS+D_DEPTHLESS pair signature.
Apply the declared owner map only to the four D bucket counts.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Freeze candidate catalogs, dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.
measurements: structural image rank and kernel relative to the separated control
antiCircularity: All four owner maps and their order are frozen before scalar inspection.
No owner-specific exception, delta key, or state is selected using W/D/L.
C roleless counts, SIGNED_PARITY filtering, and depthless grouping are inherited unchanged from EW-RS-073.
falsifiers: D_SEPARATED must reproduce RS-073 ranks 73,262,14 with zero contradictions.
Any candidate with zero structural residue and nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No post-hoc owner exception is allowed.
nextIfOwnerLabelsRemovable: Freeze the coarsest passing owner quotient and test presence/parity/ZOE/exact count algebra on its remaining small signed buckets.
nextIfSeparatedRequired: Retain owner separation and test the same bucket-count algebra before any coefficient fit.
interpretationGuards: Owner-label quotient sufficiency is bounded Q-V evidence.
D_UNORDERED_CHANNELS removes absolute owner identity but does not merge the two channels.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
